intro: A running log of what's on my plate: the day job, the stage, and the table.

professional.title: Program Manager, Enablement of Technical Product Content
professional.description: Leading the conversion of 24 instructor-led training manuals into hands-on e-learning labs and courses across 7 product lines, and owning the release plan that keeps enablement in step with product launches.

professional.title: Cyber Defense Educator / Curriculum Developer
professional.description: Still teaching: training customers, partners and analysts on Darktrace's AI-driven cyber defense platform, with an 83 NPS over six years.

professional.title: Personal apps
professional.description: Small tools that update themselves: a baritenor audition finder, a scoreboard for my teams, a Brandon housing watch, and Campaign Forge.

professional.title: Jonathan's Apothecary of Scents
professional.description: Fantasy- and TTRPG-themed home fragrance. Brewing Comfort, One Fragrance At a Time.

upcoming_empty_note: Between shows and auditioning around Tampa Bay. Next role coming soon.

past_shows.blurb: My debut with New Tampa Players: a Newfoundland accent, a constable's swagger, and one of the best ensembles I've been part of.
